name: not-congruent
description: A congruence sign crossed by a cancellation stroke.
useCase: Indicate that two shapes or forms are not congruent.
misuse: Pair this symbol with a clear label when its meaning depends on context.

16.reason: The complete cancellation stroke crosses the same full wave and equality bars as the congruent control.

24.reason: The full cancellation stroke distinguishes the mark while its wave and equality bars match the congruent control.
